sources.quote: is planning on launching the claim against FTSE 100 firms Barratt Redrow and Persimmon, FTSE 250 companies Taylor Wimpey, Berkeley and Bellway as well as Bloor Homes, Vistry Group and its Countryside Partnerships division.

sources.title: Housebuilding giants hit with £4.5bn lawsuit for allegedly overcharging buyers
sources.quote: The lawsuit, led by McLaren, and represented by competition law firms Geradin Partners and Hausfeld, alleges the property buyers paid more for homes because of less competition between the major housebuilders, for more than ten years.
